name: General Paper on Teaching & Research Aptitude (Paper 1)
description: Official common compulsory paper for all UGC NET aspirants assessing teaching methods, research methodology, cognitive reasoning, ICT, and higher education systems.

name: Computer Science and Applications
description: Official UGC NET Subject 87 for postgraduates in Computer Science, MCA, M.Tech CSE/IT, covering core systems, algorithms, theoretical computer science, databases, and AI.

name: Electronic Science
description: Official UGC NET Subject 88 applicable for Electronics, ECE, and Instrumentation postgraduates covering semiconductor physics, VLSI, microcontrollers, communication and signal processing.

name: Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
description: Supplementary technical specialization encompassing deep learning architectures, reinforcement learning, transformers, generative models, and LLM orchestration.

name: Data Science & Advanced Analytics
description: Supplementary applied domain covering big data systems (Hadoop/Spark), probabilistic models, statistical inferencing, data pipelines, and business intelligence.

name: Computer Vision & Pattern Recognition
description: Supplementary visual computing domain covering convolutional networks, object detection (YOLO/Faster R-CNN), image segmentation, and vision transformers.

name: Natural Language Processing & LLMs
description: Supplementary linguistic intelligence domain covering tokenization, word embeddings, attention mechanisms, BERT/GPT architectures, and retrieval augmented generation (RAG).
